name: glass-planet
description: The Worst Planet Ever Discovered — a 3D short documentary about HD 189733 b (Remotion + React Three Fiber)

scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts GlassPlanetVertical out/glass-planet-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:wide: remotion render src/index.ts GlassPlanetWide out/glass-planet-wide.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:wide
